answer: An identity climbs a terrace of audit gates before it can earn. Each gate is sampled by a prism drawn from the prior emission hash, unpredictable and re-drawn each epoch, so an attacker cannot know which sybils get checked - the whole fleet must behave honestly. Only identities whose work is proven independently generated earn a non-transferable jade token unlocking rewards. Honesty does not scale: every fake identity proves independence separately, per-identity, per-gate, unbuyable. Forging a jade token means passing random audit at fleet scale, growing linearly, unbypassable by one payment.
